officialSeasonAndSpecs.evidence: The HEAD regional product page explicitly identifies season 2025/2026 and article 31323506, says the set includes FF 11 GW, and gives all five size rows: 150 cm 122/68/107 mm R10.5; 155 cm 122/68/107 R11.2; 160 cm 122/68/107 R12.0; 165 cm 122/68/107 R12.9; 170 cm 122/68/107 R13.7. HEAD 25/26 Hardgoods Workbook independently maps article 313235 to Worldcup Rebels e-SL Pro, lists 150/155/160/165/170 cm, reference sidecut 122/68/107 at 160 cm and radius 12.0 m at 160 cm.

officialPriceEvidence.evidence: HEAD 2025/26 Alpine Retail Price List lists article 313235, model WC Rebels e-SL Pro RP WCR 14, sizes 150/155/160/165/170, MSRP USD 1,125 and MAP USD 999. Binding-in-package field is blank/dashes, so the MSRP is treated as ski-only.

currencyConversion.formula: 1359 CAD / 1.5918 CAD per EUR * 7.4925 CNY per EUR

officialCanadaBundleCrossCheck.evidence: HEAD Canada's official 313235.SET page shows CAD 1,359 as final price, status Out of Stock, and offers FREEFLEX 14 GW. This is a binding-equipped regional package and is recorded separately from the US official bare-ski MSRP. The official CDN image URL is under the same 313235.SET / 31323505 product path.

crossSeasonCheck.evidence: The HEAD 26/27 workbook assigns article 313236 to WC Rebels e-SL Pro. It is maintained in a separate 2026/27 seed and its price/image/specs are not used as evidence for 313235.
